title: Delegation delivery: CoAP provisioning + persistence for prefix delegations (spec 8.7.2)
description: Spec 05-routing.md 8.7.2 defines how the root DELIVERS delegations: POST coap://[delegate]/.well-known/prefix-delegation, Content-Format application/cose cose-sign1, OSCORE root-delegate pairwise context, COSE_Sign1 payload {prefix, prefix_len, delegate_iid, E flag, delegation_seq, expiry}; node verifies root signature, delegation_seq > cached, caches by (prefix, prefix_len); root SHOULD send delegation on capability announce (spec 8.12 bit 1) or admin config. Nothing implements this. Scope: CoAP resource on root + handler on delegate, delegation_seq persistence, expiry enforcement, OSCORE requirement. The in-flight Rust PrefixDelegations table explicitly documents 'Provisioning and persistence out of scope; operator API seeded, re-seeded after restart' - this bead closes that gap per spec. Cross-impl alignment with python delegation_tokens.py. Decomposed from project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2.
